item.title: Dog faeces on playing equipment at the Park and also a black bag with dogfaces left on the grass, 14th November
item.description:
Dog faeces found on playing equipment at the Park. My children didn’t realised and ended up getting it on their hands and clothing. I also noticed a black plastic dog bag full of what I believe is faeces left on the grass. I had to go home and get antibacterial wipes to remove the faeces of the playing equipment and to clean my children’s hand, I did remove the faeces off of the plane equipment,but not sure if there is any other faeces anywhere else or on any other equipment.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 34, Oakleaze, Elmbridge, Gloucester
